_meta.role: Software Engineer, CUDA Deep Learning Systems

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on experience across CUDA kernel optimization and deep learning systems. Built custom CUDA C++ kernels with memory coalescing for GPU inference speedups, quantized and profiled a large language model for VRAM and latency, and deployed TensorRT-optimized inference on NVIDIA Jetson. Background spans PyTorch and HuggingFace model pipelines, performance profiling, and low-level systems optimization from a single GPU kernel to an end to end inference pipeline.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT, an OCR-free visual document understanding Transformer, on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using the HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API, adding domain-specific special tokens and resizing the decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and trained YOLOv8n on a custom 1,133 image annotated dataset, achieving 83% mAP@50 on held out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline with augmentation and batch-loading memory management for the large-scale 3D volumetric BraTS 2020 MRI dataset.
Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Achieved a 35% speedup over naive GPU execution (49.2ms vs 73.3ms) and 1.5–2x speedup over CPU TorchScript, with identical classification accuracy, by replacing VGG16 convolution layers with custom CUDA C++ kernels.
Designed the kernels around memory coalescing, constant memory for weights and biases, and preallocated global buffers to eliminate per-layer allocation overhead.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B, profiling peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types with pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC with under 1% accuracy degradation and a +0.09 perplexity increase, demonstrating near-lossless compression.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved a 5.2x inference speedup (56.7→10.9ms, 17.6→92 FPS) by converting a YOLO perception model to TensorRT for real time visual servoing on NVIDIA Jetson.
Resolved 11 integration failures across a three layer distributed pipeline (Flutter, Flask-SocketIO, Jetson+Arduino) to achieve 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).
